name: Batrachomimus
sum: Small neosuchian from the Late Jurassic Pastos Bons Formation of Brazil, with an unusually smooth bone area on the snout.
wsnote: About 1 m estimated from skull length (Wikipedia).
holotype: LPRP/USP-0617, a skull about 20 cm long preserving most of the skull and lower jaws, from the Pastos Bons Formation.
material: Osteoderms and limb bones are also known.
biology: Its estimated body length is about 1 m.
author: Montefeltro et al. 2013

sources.text: Montefeltro, F. C.; Larsson, H. C. E.; de França, M. A. G.; Langer, M. C. 2013. A new neosuchian with Asian affinities from the Jurassic of northeastern Brazil. Naturwissenschaften 100(9): 835–841. doi:10.1007/s00114-013-1083-9
